Hello, I tried loading the shapefile for the study region,.shp,.shx,.dbf, but the interface freezes. is there anything I am not doing right?
I would appreciate your help.
Kind regards,
Vincent Wanga

> > The csv headers need to be lowercase: scientific_name, longitude, and latitude, and the species need to be written as Genus species, without the additional information.
> >

> > >
> > > Hello,
> > > I am trying to load my dataset in the user-defined section, but it seems to bring errors. What could be the problem? My CSV file is arranged in the snipped piece above
> > > Kind regards,
> > > Vincent Wanga
> > >
> > > On Wed, Nov 20, 2024 at 12:36 AM Vincent Wanga <vincen...@gmail.com> wrote:
> > > > Thank you very much
> > > >
> > > > On Wed, Nov 20, 2024 at 12:27 AM Wallace EcoMod <wallac...@gmail.com> wrote:
> > > > > You may receive an error trying to install regarding the package changeranger. That is currently off CRAN an also needs to be downloaded prior to installing v3 (apologies, I forgot to mention this). We are in the process getting it back on CRAN, but if you see the error, just run this first:
> > > > >
> > > > > devtools::install_github("https://github.com/wallaceEcoMod/changeRangeR")
